title: Count Operations, Not Syntax
summary: Estimate growth by counting how many times the expensive operation can occur across the whole algorithm, rather than judging from indentation alone.
recognition_signals: runtime depends on an operation repeated with input size
nested loops may share monotonic progress
a loop body contains search, membership, shifting, or another non-constant operation
core_rules: Analyze the dominant operation and how often it can run over the entire execution.
A syntactically nested loop is not automatically quadratic when its inner pointer only moves forward a bounded total number of times.
structural_steps: bound how many times one input item can participate in it
sum that work across all items

common_confusions.distinction: Complexity analysis explains why a baseline is slow; the baseline-to-bottleneck family uses that analysis to guide an optimization.
